prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated character colors, simple chunky shapes, a strong readable silhouette and one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery. Modest detail appropriate for a small card. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or separate panels. Do not imitate an existing copyrighted card illustration. Clear plausible anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: An adult anthropomorphic ginger cat woman in a green fantasy rogue tunic and tall boots. Exactly two arms and two legs, one curved tail. She poses smugly with one paw resting on her hip and the other paw holding a tiny innocent-looking feather duster as a weapon; a huge playful toothy grin and whiskers. Friendly comic menace, fully clothed, no sexualization.
